reason: This plugin is primarily a chat input utility that improves message composition workflow by enabling keyboard-based recall of recent sent messages in the current session, with mode-aware behavior to preserve normal caret movement. Evidence in the README and manifest points to a small browser client plugin for DeepSeek Harness rather than automation, analysis, or external-service tooling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness Web 的聊天输入框插件，通过方向键在当前会话内快速召回并切换已发送消息历史，在检测到光标定位后恢复普通上下移动。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web chat composer plugin that lets users browse recently sent messages with Up/Down keys and resumes normal cursor movement when caret-positioning actions are used.

capabilities: Intercepts keyboard events in the web composer and conditionally handles Up/Down for history navigation
Reads current session conversation snapshots to collect user-message history for recall
Writes recalled history text back into the composer draft via the platform input facade
Switches behavior between history recall and normal cursor movement based on caret/selection actions

reasons.code: README describes this plugin as a DeepSeek Harness Web input-field plugin that enables terminal-like Up/Down recall of sent-message history and caret-mode fallback for normal cursor movement.
README states history is sourced from current conversation snapshots and draft updates use conversation.input.for(actx).setDraft().
package.json declares this as a DSH web client plugin with platform=web and client bundle injection, indicating browser-side runtime behavior.
